name: MOJA Arts Festival
tip: Annual celebration of African American and Caribbean arts. Don't miss the outdoor gospel and jazz concerts at Waterfront Park pier.

name: Fort Sumter Twilight & Harbor History Cruise
venue: Departure from Aquarium Wharf (340 Concord St)
tip: The 4:00 PM sunset departure provides golden-hour views of Castle Pinckney, Fort Sumter, and the Battery skyline from the water. Dolphins frequently escort the boat near Fort Johnson.

name: High Wire Distilling: Heritage Grain & Rum Tasting
tip: Daily tours and tastings centered around revived heirloom Jimmy Red Corn whiskey. Their modern copper-pot tasting room on Upper King offers flight tastings and cocktail classes.

name: Live Jazz Nightly at High Cotton
venue: 199 East Bay Street (Directly across from The Palmetto)
tip: Keys to Charleston Partner. Present your Palmetto room key for a complimentary dessert with entrée. Live jazz ensemble plays Tuesday - Sunday evenings.

name: The Commodore Late-Night Funk & Soul Revue
tip: Throwback vintage 1970s jazz and funk club with velvet booths, a sunken brass dance floor, and premier touring musicians. Live music kicks off after 9:30 PM. Great weekend late-night energy.

name: Boone Hall Fright Nights & Autumn Festival
tip: Daytime features pumpkin patches and scenic tractor tours under the Avenue of Oaks. After dark, South Carolina's largest haunted attraction operates Thursday–Sunday. Purchase tickets online in advance.

name: Charleston Gallery Association First Friday Artwalk
venue: French Quarter Historic District (2 blocks from The Palmetto)
tip: Over 20 fine art galleries host evening receptions with complimentary wine and light bites. Easy walking tour starting right outside our doors.

name: Charleston Farmers Market
tip: Saturdays 8:00 AM - 2:00 PM. Local artisans, Sweetgrass basket weavers, crepes, and live Lowcountry bluegrass. Great morning coffee stroll.

name: Pour House Sunday Brunch Farmers Market
tip: 11:00 AM - 3:00 PM every Sunday behind the iconic music venue. Local food trucks, vintage goods, farm fresh produce, and live outdoor deck jam.

name: Best of Broadway: MRS. DOUBTFIRE
tip: Hilarious, heartfelt musical comedy based on the beloved hit film. Multiple evening and weekend matinee performances. Excellent pairing with dinner in Park Circle nearby.

name: Willow Avalon with Clover County
tip: Rising indie country and folk sensation bringing authentic southern storytelling to Charleston's historic rock club. Doors at 7:30 PM, show at 8:00 PM.

name: On the Border: The Ultimate Eagles Tribute
tip: Top-rated Eagles tribute act performing five-part vocal harmonies and classic hits like "Hotel California" and "Desperado". Historic intimate acoustics. Show at 8:00 PM.

name: Preservation Society Fall Tours of Homes & Gardens
tip: Exclusive access inside private historic antebellum mansions and secluded private gardens. Afternoon walking tours sell out weeks in advance.

name: Russian Circles with Pelican
tip: Heavy instrumental post-rock powerhouses on co-headlining tour. Immense sonic wall of sound. Show at 8:00 PM.

name: Charleston City Market Night Market
venue: Historic Charleston City Market (Church to East Bay St)
tip: Open Friday and Saturday evenings 6:30 PM - 10:30 PM. Over 100 100% locally certified artists and artisans selling handmade jewelry, Sweetgrass baskets, leatherwork, and Lowcountry art under gas lanterns.

name: Charleston RiverDogs Baseball (Home Finale Weekend)
venue: Joseph P. Riley, Jr. Park (The Joe)
tip: Great sunset views over the Ashley River marsh from the first-base concourse. Craft beer specials on Thursday and post-game fireworks Friday.

name: Jordan Klepper: Live Stand-Up
tip: Daily Show contributor and satirist Jordan Klepper brings sharp wit, political satire, and personal storytelling to Upper King. Doors open at 6:00 PM, show at 7:00 PM.

name: MercyMe with Jeremy Camp & Tim Timmons
tip: Grammy-nominated multi-platinum Christian rock band live in arena concert. Show kicks off at 7:00 PM. On-site Coliseum parking available ($10–$15).

name: The Windjammer Sunset Deck Concerts
venue: 1008 Ocean Blvd (Isle of Palms - 20 min drive)
tip: Legendary oceanfront beach bar operating since 1972. Outdoor stage sits directly on the dunes overlooking the Atlantic surf. Grab a cold beer as the sun dips.

name: BALTHVS with DJ Zevyman
tip: Colombian psychedelic funk trio blending cumbia, surf rock, and Turkish disco rhythms. Super danceable vibe. Show at 8:00 PM.

name: Charleston Battery USL Championship Match
tip: Stunning views of the Ravenel Bridge from the stadium stands. High-energy supporter culture with food trucks and local craft beer tents along the harbor breeze.

name: The Black Jacket Symphony: Def Leppard's Hysteria
tip: Note-for-note, sound-for-sound live performance of Def Leppard's iconic album "Hysteria" followed by a full set of rock greatest hits. Show at 7:30 PM.

name: Second Sunday on King Street
venue: Lower King Street (Queen St to Calhoun St)
tip: King Street closes completely to vehicular traffic from 12:00 PM to 5:00 PM. Cafes set up outdoor dining in the roadway, local musicians perform on street corners, and boutiques offer street-side hospitality.

name: Thundercat with special guest TiaCorine
tip: Grammy-winning virtuoso bassist and singer Thundercat blends funk, jazz fusion, and R&B. One of the hottest concert bookings of the fall season. Show at 8:00 PM.

name: Cannons with Caroline Kingsbury
tip: Dreamy indie-pop and synth-wave trio Cannons perform their hit "Fire for You" and new album tracks. Doors at 7:00 PM, show at 8:00 PM.

name: All Them Witches with Emma Ruth Rundle
tip: Psychedelic blues and heavy desert rock ensemble paired with dark folk artist Emma Ruth Rundle. Show at 8:00 PM.

name: Dock Street Theatre: Fall Repertory Drama
venue: Historic Dock Street Theatre (135 Church St - 3 min walk)
tip: America's first historic theatre building (opened 1736). Intimate historic setting with cypress woodwork. Grab pre-show cocktails at The Spectator or The Griffon just around the corner.

name: Nevertel with Rivals & Ocean Sleeper
tip: Genre-bending rap-rock and modern metal outfit live at the Farm. Doors at 7:30 PM, show at 8:00 PM.

name: Scott Bradlee's Postmodern Jukebox
tip: Global sensation reimagining modern pop, rock, and hip-hop hits into 1920s vintage swing, doo-wop, and ragtime jazz. Incredible vocalists and tap dancers. Show at 8:00 PM.

name: Black Violin: The Be Free Tour
tip: Classical crossover virtuosos merging violin with hip-hop beats, live turntablism, and full symphony orchestration. Exceptional listening acoustics in the performance hall.

name: Mark Normand: Ya Don't Say Tour
tip: High-octane rapid-fire observational stand-up from Netflix star Mark Normand. Doors at 6:00 PM, show at 7:00 PM.

name: sunn O))) with special guest Shane Parish
tip: Legendary experimental drone metal duo creating physical, room-shaking acoustic vibrations with fog and full amplifiers. Bring earplugs! Show at 8:00 PM.

name: Charleston Symphony Orchestra: Masterworks Opening
tip: World-class acoustics in the Gaillard hall. Arrive 45 minutes prior for the free pre-concert lecture with the conductor. Excellent pairing with dinner at Zero Restaurant + Bar or Circa 1886.

name: Eddie 9V with Eddie Bush
tip: Soul-stirring retro blues, Memphis soul, and infectious funk guitar. Show at 8:00 PM. Great night out in the brewery district.

name: Gabriel Iglesias: The 1976 Tour
tip: "Fluffy" brings his brand-new stand-up arena comedy tour to North Charleston. Show begins at 8:00 PM. High-demand show; book early for lower-bowl seating.

name: The Marshall Tucker Band Live in Concert
tip: South Carolina's own Southern rock legends performing "Can't You See", "Heard It in a Love Song", and classic blues jams. Show at 8:00 PM.

name: Trampled by Turtles with The Last Revel
tip: High-speed progressive bluegrass and folk-rock ensemble outdoors at The Refinery amphitheater on Upper Meeting Street. Food trucks and local craft beer on site.

name: Charleston Jazz: What a Wonderful World (Bruce Harris)
tip: Acclaimed jazz trumpeter Bruce Harris joins the Charleston Jazz Orchestra in tribute to Louis Armstrong. Afternoon and evening performances.

name: Drayton Hall Candlelight & Landscape Tour
tip: The only intact, unrestored plantation house surviving both the Revolutionary and Civil Wars. Evening tours by candlelight illuminate 18th-century plasterwork rarely accessible after dark.

name: Firefly Distillery: Live Music on the Field
tip: Expansive 5-acre outdoor lawn with food trucks, cocktail stations featuring sweet tea vodka, and outdoor concerts. Bring lawn blankets or folding chairs.

name: North Charleston POPS! Rocket Man: The Music of Elton
tip: Full symphonic tribute celebrating the timeless rock catalog of Sir Elton John, featuring guest vocalists and the complete North Charleston POPS! orchestra. Show at 7:30 PM.

name: SC Stingrays vs. Greenville Swamp Rabbits (Opening Night)
tip: ECHL professional hockey home opener! Puck drops at 6:05 PM with magnet schedule giveaways and pre-game fan festivities on the concourse. Great family atmosphere.

name: The Red Clay Strays: Grateful Tour
tip: Lexus Concert Series on Daniel Island. Southern rock sensation with The Revivalists and Haley Reinhart opening. Gates open at 5:30 PM, show at 7:00 PM. Take rideshare across the Wando River.

name: Holy City Farmers Market at Holy City Brewing
tip: Waterfront marsh setting along Noisette Creek. Every third Sunday with 30+ artisan vendors, live music, craft beers on tap, and casual Lowcountry barbecue.

name: Town of Mount Pleasant Children's Day Festival
tip: Annual fall festival featuring carnival games, giant slides, live family entertainment, and food trucks. Great family day trip across the Ravenel Bridge.

name: Alana Springsteen with Kyle Schuesler
tip: Rising modern country star and powerhouse vocalist performing anthems from her album Twenty Something. Doors at 7:30 PM, show at 8:00 PM.

name: Charleston Music Hall: Acoustic Masters Series
tip: A historic 1850s passenger station converted into an acoustic jewel-box theater. Outstanding sightlines from both floor and balcony. Fantastic pre-concert dinner options at The Ordinary or Halls Chophouse.

name: Disney On Ice Presents Magic of Family
tip: Beloved Disney characters from Encanto, Frozen, Moana, and Toy Story skate across the arena ice with world-class acrobatics and special effects. Multiple daily family matinees.

name: Watch What Happens Live with Andy Cohen (Bravo Fan Fest)
tip: Andy Cohen films special live tapings of WWHL in Charleston featuring Southern Charm cast members and Bravo universe celebrities. Doors at 7:00 PM.

name: Charleston Beer Week
tip: Over 30 independent craft breweries host special barrel releases, block parties, and pairings. Edmund's Oast, Revelry Brewing rooftop, and Palmetto Brewing are all standout stops.

name: Johnny Blue Skies & the Dark Clouds: Mutiny for the Masses Tour
tip: Sturgill Simpson's alter ego Johnny Blue Skies touring his acclaimed rock and outlaw country project. Open-air stadium setting under the stars. Show starts at 8:00 PM.

name: The Hip Abduction with Sensamotion
tip: Upbeat tropical indie-rock and West African kora-infused grooves. High-energy crowd favorite. Show at 7:00 PM.

name: Bravo Fan Fest 2026
tip: Full-day fan festival with celebrity panels, Q&A sessions with Southern Charm cast members, photo activations, and exclusive VIP cocktail lounges.

name: Emo Night Brooklyn: Halloween Edition
tip: Massive interactive Halloween party spinning 2000s emo, pop-punk, and alternative anthems with live guest musicians and full costume contest. Starts at 9:00 PM.

name: The Rocky Horror Picture Show with Live Shadowcast
tip: Halloween weekend cult classic screening with live actors performing alongside the screen. Prop bags and full costume contest. Doors at 6:00 PM, show at 7:00 PM.

name: Rumours of Fleetwood Mac (Official Tribute Tour)
tip: Personally endorsed by Mick Fleetwood, this acclaimed British touring ensemble flawlessly recreates Fleetwood Mac's legendary 1970s and 80s concert experience.

name: CeCe Winans: COME WORSHIP! Tour
tip: 15-time Grammy Award winner CeCe Winans leads an uplifting evening of gospel and worship music. Show starts at 7:00 PM.

name: Sonic Live in Concert
tip: A high-definition multimedia symphony orchestra playing iconic themes and tracks from Sonic the Hedgehog gaming history alongside synchronized giant-screen gameplay footage.

name: South Carolina Ballet: Dracula
tip: Sensual and dramatic Halloween gothic ballet set to a thrilling orchestral score with elaborate costumes and haunting staging. Show at 7:30 PM.

name: SC Stingrays vs. Savannah Ghost Pirates (Emo Night)
tip: Rivalry hockey matchup paired with an upbeat Emo Night soundtrack, specialty black jerseys, and drink specials throughout the evening. Puck drops at 7:05 PM.

name: Hawthorne Heights with letlive. & Creeper
tip: Post-hardcore and emo icons Hawthorne Heights live in concert with letlive. Doors at 6:00 PM, show at 7:00 PM.

name: SC Stingrays vs. Atlanta Gladiators
tip: Scooby Doo Day & Undie Sunday. Afternoon family matinee. Puck drops at 3:05 PM at North Charleston Coliseum.

name: Jake Shimabukuro Live in Concert
tip: World-renowned ukulele virtuoso known for blistering covers of "While My Guitar Gently Weeps" and bohemian classical jazz. Show at 8:00 PM.

name: College of Charleston Men's Basketball vs. Southern Wesleyan
tip: Cougars Regular Season Home Opener! Tip-off at 7:30 PM at TD Arena. Just a 10-minute walk from The Palmetto.

name: Jerry Seinfeld: Live Stand-Up
tip: Legendary observational stand-up comedian Jerry Seinfeld live on stage. Evening performance at 7:00 PM. High-demand show; book tickets early.

name: Drake Milligan Live on the Beach Stage
tip: High-energy traditional country rocker Drake Milligan live at Charleston's famous beachfront music venue. Ocean breeze, cold beer, and live honky-tonk rock. Show at 8:00 PM.

name: Charleston City Market Night Market (Fall & Holiday Series)
venue: Historic Charleston City Market (Church to East Bay St)
tip: Friday & Saturday evenings 6:30 PM - 10:30 PM. 100% locally certified artists and craftsmen selling handmade jewelry, sweetgrass baskets, leatherwork, and art under soft gas lanterns.

name: Charleston Gallery Association First Friday Artwalk (November)
venue: French Quarter Historic District (2 blocks from The Palmetto)
tip: Over 20 galleries along East Bay, Queen, and Church streets open their doors from 5:00 PM - 8:00 PM with complimentary wine and artist meet-and-greets. Starts right on our block!

name: Charleston Literary Festival
venue: Dock Street Theatre & Circular Congregational Church
tip: Partnered with the UK's renowned Charleston Festival. World-class intimate conversations between Pulitzer and Booker Prize-winning authors. Book sessions early as venues hold under 450 guests.

name: SC Stingrays vs. Orlando Solar Bears
tip: Jets and Vets Military Appreciation Night. Fast-paced ECHL rivalry hockey. Puck drops at 7:05 PM.

name: College of Charleston Men's Basketball vs. Newberry
tip: Friday night college hoops at TD Arena. Great downtown basketball atmosphere. Tip-off at 7:00 PM.

name: Good Cop / Rad Cop (Musical Comedy Duo)
tip: High-energy musical comedy duo from Atlanta as seen on Netflix and Moontower Comedy Fest. Fast banter, guitar, and hilarious crowdwork. Shows Friday–Sunday.

name: Charleston County Parks Harvest Festival
venue: Johns Island County Park (2662 Mullet Hall Rd)
tip: Traditional fall celebration with 5 live bluegrass bands, barbecue, pumpkin decorating, craft vendors, and scenic hayrides through the oak trails. 11:00 AM – 5:00 PM.

name: Charleston Scottish Games & Highland Gathering
tip: The second oldest Scottish Games in the US. Features caber tossing, pipe bands, Scottish country dancing, border collie herding demonstrations, and whiskey tastings along the Cooper River.

name: SC Stingrays vs. Orlando Solar Bears
tip: Weekend evening matchup against Orlando. Concourse games and family fun. Puck drops at 6:05 PM.

name: Wynonna Judd: The Hard Truth Tour
tip: Country Music Hall of Famer Wynonna Judd brings her powerhouse vocals, storytelling, and classic Judds hits to Charleston. Show at 7:30 PM.

name: Second Sunday on King Street (November Edition)
venue: Lower King Street (Queen St to Calhoun St)
tip: Vehicle-free pedestrian haven from 12:00 PM to 5:00 PM. Boutique shopping, outdoor bistro tables in the middle of King St, live musicians, and dog-friendly socializing. Only 4 blocks west of The Palmetto.

name: Tab Benoit with Jesse Dayton
tip: Grammy-nominated Louisiana bayou blues guitar maestro Tab Benoit performs swamp-blues and soul with outlaw country virtuoso Jesse Dayton. Show at 8:00 PM.

name: Charleston Battery USL Championship Playoff Match
tip: USL Championship postseason professional soccer at Patriots Point! High-stakes playoff atmosphere, supporter smoke, food trucks, and craft beer gardens along the harbor.

name: UB40: Red Red Wine Tour
tip: Legendary British reggae-pop band performing iconic global hits "Red Red Wine", "Can't Help Falling in Love", and "Kingston Town". Show at 8:00 PM.

name: Spyro Gyra Live in Concert
tip: Grammy-nominated jazz-fusion innovators celebrating over 40 years of instrumental excellence. Doors at 7:00 PM, show at 8:00 PM.

name: Jonnie W. Live Stand-Up
tip: Viral Drybar Comedy sensation and SiriusXM favorite blending music and off-beat observational stand-up. Evening show at 8:00 PM.

name: Holiday Festival of Lights
tip: Over 2 million holiday lights along a 3-mile drive. Park the car midway to roast marshmallows at outdoor fire pits, ride the carousel, and walk the lakefront trail. Go on a weekday to avoid long bridge queues.

name: Paula Cole with special guest Rett Madison
tip: Grammy-winning singer-songwriter behind "Where Have All the Cowboys Gone?" and "I Don't Want to Wait". Intimate acoustic listening room experience.

name: The Wrecks with Worry Club & Kid Sistr
tip: Infectious indie alt-rock quintet bringing high energy and crowd sing-alongs. Doors open at 7:30 PM, show at 8:00 PM.

name: The Motet with Special Guests Live at Pour House
tip: Legendary Denver funk and Afrobeat pioneers bring explosive brass grooves and dance rhythm to Charleston's premier live music institution. Outdoor deck set at 6 PM, main stage at 9 PM.

name: Middleton Place Autumn Heritage Gathering
tip: America's oldest landscaped gardens featuring centuries-old camellias and terraced butterfly lakes. Demonstrations of traditional indigo dyeing, coopering, and blacksmithing.

name: Pecos & The Rooftops with Jaxon Malone
tip: Texas country-rock outfit known for their viral platinum hit "This Damn Song". Smoky vocals and gritty guitars. Show at 8:00 PM.

name: Travis Tritt Live in Concert
tip: Grammy-winning outlaw country icon performing acoustic and electric hits like 'T-R-O-U-B-L-E' and 'It's a Great Day to Be Alive'. Doors at 7:00 PM, show at 8:00 PM.

name: Hudson Westbrook: The Hits Me Tour Live at Firefly
tip: Rising country star Hudson Westbrook performs live on the five-acre outdoor concert field at Firefly Distillery. Local food trucks and craft cocktails on-site. Doors at 6:00 PM.

name: College of Charleston Men's Basketball vs. South Carolina State
tip: Sunday afternoon in-state college basketball matinee at TD Arena. Tip-off at 2:00 PM.

name: Best of Broadway: THE BODYGUARD
tip: Breathtaking romantic thriller musical based on the smash-hit film, featuring Whitney Houston's greatest hits including 'I Will Always Love You'. Evening and weekend matinees.

name: Big Head Todd & the Monsters (Two-Night Run)
tip: Celebrated Colorado blues-rock outfit playing back-to-back nights. Hits like "Bittersweet" and deep catalog fan favorites. Shows at 8:00 PM.

name: SC Stingrays vs. Greensboro Gargoyles
tip: Friday night divisional clash against Greensboro. Puck drops at 7:05 PM. On-site arena parking available.

name: Fiona Cauley: Live Stand-Up
tip: Kill Tony Golden Ticket winner and Nashville headliner known for sharp, punchline-heavy dark comedy. Friday and Saturday shows at 7:00 PM & 9:30 PM.

name: Grand Kyiv Ballet: Swan Lake (Symphony of Lights)
tip: Renowned Ukrainian ballet company presents Tchaikovsky's classic masterpiece featuring Ukrainian principal dancers in a stunning classical staging. Show at 7:00 PM.

name: Kurt Vile & the Violators with Twisted Teens
tip: Acclaimed indie rock guitar hero and former War on Drugs member Kurt Vile brings his laid-back psychedelic folk-rock style. Doors at 7:00 PM, show at 8:00 PM.

name: The Royal American Winter Indie Showcase
tip: Cult-favorite Upper Peninsula live music bar hosting premier touring indie and garage rock bands. Grab homemade frozen punches and diner fare on the patio. Show at 9:00 PM.

name: Mannheim Steamroller Christmas by Chip Davis
tip: America's favorite holiday tradition live in concert, blending classical symphonic orchestration with modern rock rhythm and dazzling multimedia effects. Show at 7:30 PM.

name: An Evening with Band of Horses (Two-Night Hometown Stand)
tip: Charleston indie rock royalty returns for their traditional Thanksgiving week hometown residency. Expect emotional anthems like "The Funeral" and "No One's Gonna Love You".

name: Turkey Day 5K & Harborfront Thanksgiving Stroll
tip: Charleston's oldest continuous running event. The scenic course winds down Meeting Street, around The Battery and White Point Garden, and back up East Bay Street past The Palmetto.
ticket: Race Registration Required ($35–$50) / Free to Spectate

name: SC Stingrays vs. Savannah Ghost Pirates
tip: Thanksgiving weekend hockey! Bitter South Division rivalry vs. Savannah. Great energetic atmosphere. Puck drops at 7:05 PM.

name: Charlton Singleton's Holiday Spectacular feat. Quiana Parler
tip: Grammy Award winners and Ranky Tanky founders Charlton Singleton and Quiana Parler deliver a joyful Thanksgiving weekend show of R&B, soul, and Gullah holiday classics.

name: SC Stingrays vs. Savannah Ghost Pirates
tip: Saturday night rematch against the Ghost Pirates. High-intensity rivalry hockey. Puck drops at 6:05 PM.

name: Lindsey Stirling: The Snow Waltz Tour
tip: Electronic violinist and dancer Lindsey Stirling performs high-energy choreography, aerial acrobatics, and holiday classics from her chart-topping Christmas album. Show at 8:00 PM.

name: College of Charleston Men's Basketball vs. Howard
tip: Thanksgiving weekend Sunday hoops vs. Howard Bison at TD Arena. Tip-off at 2:00 PM.

name: South Carolina Ballet: The Nutcracker
tip: Grand annual classical production of The Nutcracker with dazzling sets, falling snow, and world-class choreography. Evening performances at 7:00 PM.

name: Charleston Stage: A Christmas Carol at Dock Street Theatre
venue: Historic Dock Street Theatre (135 Church St - 3 min walk)
tip: A cherished Charleston holiday tradition in America's oldest theater. Features period Victorian costumes, original musical scores, and flying spirits. Highly recommended for couples and families.

name: Tommy Emmanuel, CGP Live in Concert
tip: Widely considered one of the greatest acoustic fingerstyle guitarists on the planet. Mesmerizing one-man virtuoso performance. Show at 8:00 PM.

name: Emo Philips Live in Concert
tip: Legendary stand-up comic hailed by Jay Leno as "the best joke writer in America" and touring partner of "Weird Al" Yankovic. One night only at 8:00 PM.

name: FILMORE: Live on the Inside Stage
tip: Country-pop breakout artist FILMORE bringing stadium-ready energy to the intimate oceanfront club. Show at 8:00 PM.

name: Charleston Gallery Association First Friday Artwalk (December)
venue: French Quarter Historic District (2 blocks from The Palmetto)
tip: Festive holiday gallery walk with champagne toasts, holiday artwork debuts, and live chamber music in historic French Quarter studios. Ideal pre-dinner stroll.

name: SC Stingrays vs. Atlanta Gladiators
tip: Friday night divisional hockey vs. Atlanta. Great weekend kickoff. Puck drops at 7:05 PM.

name: Steve Martin & Martin Short Live
venue: North Charleston Coliseum & Performing Arts Center
tip: Comedy legends Steve Martin & Martin Short in an evening of riotous jokes, banjo playing, musical numbers, and showbiz stories. Show at 8:00 PM.

name: Adrienne Iapalucci: The Dark Queen Tour
tip: NYC Comedy Cellar regular whose hit special "The Dark Queen" is streaming on Netflix. Unapologetic, razor-sharp stand-up. Friday & Saturday shows at 7:00 & 9:30 PM.

name: Elf: The Musical (Holiday Production)
venue: Queen Street Playhouse (20 Queen St - 4 min walk)
tip: Hilarious Broadway holiday musical based on the classic Will Ferrell film, staged in an intimate historic 1850s cotton warehouse playhouse in the French Quarter. Evening and Sunday matinees.

name: Charleston Holiday Boat Parade on the Harbor
venue: Charleston Harbor (Joe Riley Waterfront Park Pier)
tip: Dozens of illuminated sailboats and yachts parade along the harbor from the Cooper River past Waterfront Park to The Battery. Step right out of The Palmetto to Waterfront Park pier for front-row views!

name: Holiday Market at Marion Square
tip: Saturdays & Sundays in December from 9:00 AM - 3:00 PM. Local holiday artisans, festive baked goods, live brass bands, carolers, and free photos with Santa Claus under the grand Christmas tree.

name: Leanne Morgan: Just Getting Started Comedy Tour
tip: Southern storytelling sensation Leanne Morgan brings her hilarious relatable brand of family comedy to Charleston. Evening performance at 7:00 PM.

name: City of Charleston Holiday Parade & Marion Square Tree Lighting
venue: Broad St to Meeting St & Marion Square
tip: Parade begins at 3:00 PM on Broad St, steps from The Palmetto, winding up Meeting St to Marion Square for the 64-foot Tree Lighting Ceremony at 6:00 PM with caroling and hot cocoa.

name: North Charleston POPS! Sounds of the Season
tip: Holiday symphony concert featuring orchestral arrangements of holiday carols, vocal soloists, and a spirited audience sing-along. Show begins at 3:00 PM.

name: College of Charleston Men's Basketball vs. Davidson
tip: Sunday non-conference showcase against historic A-10 contender Davidson. Tip-off at 2:00 PM at TD Arena.

name: Best of Broadway: A BEAUTIFUL NOISE
tip: The uplifting Neil Diamond musical telling the inspiring true story of a kid from Brooklyn who became an American rock icon, featuring 'Sweet Caroline' and 'America'.

name: College of Charleston Men's Basketball vs. Voorhees
tip: Wednesday evening non-conference action at TD Arena. Tip-off at 7:00 PM. Pair with dinner along King Street.

name: The Charleston Christmas Special (Brad & Jennifer Moranz)
tip: High-energy Broadway-style holiday musical revue featuring world-class singers, dancers, and comedy skits. Matinee and evening shows available. Pair with dinner at Halls Chophouse.

name: SC Stingrays vs. Savannah Ghost Pirates
tip: Holiday season rivalry hockey vs. Savannah. Puck drops at 7:05 PM at North Charleston Coliseum.

name: Charles McBee Live Stand-Up
tip: Head writer for Comedy Central and MTV bringing nostalgic, hilarious 80s/90s pop culture commentary. Friday–Sunday shows.

name: The Heavy Pets: Jam & Groove Showcase
tip: South Florida rhythm and rock powerhouse blending funk, jazz, and disco. One of the top live jam shows of the winter season. Doors at 8:30 PM.

name: Second Sunday on King Street (December Holiday Edition)
venue: Lower King Street (Queen St to Calhoun St)
tip: The most festive Second Sunday of the year! Holiday decor adorns storefronts, carolers stroll the avenue, and boutique sidewalk hospitality includes mulled cider and champagne.

name: SC Stingrays vs. Greenville Swamp Rabbits
tip: In-state rivalry matchup against Greenville. Sunday afternoon matinee; puck drops at 3:05 PM.

name: College of Charleston Men's Basketball vs. Northern Colorado
tip: Friday night holiday non-conference matchup at TD Arena. Tip-off at 7:00 PM.

name: Charleston Symphony: Holiday POPS! at Sottile
tip: Beloved Lowcountry holiday concert featuring the full Charleston Symphony, guest vocalists, and choir performing timeless orchestral Christmas classics. Evening & afternoon matinees.

tip: High-profile marquee matchup vs. AAC contender South Florida Bulls! Packed house expected at TD Arena. Tip-off at 7:00 PM.

name: SC Stingrays vs. Jacksonville Icemen
tip: Post-Christmas Saturday evening hockey! Massive holiday crowd expected vs. Jacksonville. Puck drops at 6:05 PM.

name: Folly Beach Flip-Flop Drop & New Year's Eve Fireworks

tip: Charleston's quirkiest New Year's tradition! A giant, sparkling pair of flip-flops drops from the sky at midnight on Center Street, followed by fireworks over the Atlantic surf.

name: Futurebirds with Arts Fishing Club (New Year's Eve)
tip: Charleston's premier live music NYE party! High-energy indie cosmic country rockers Futurebirds ring in 2027 with a midnight countdown and balloon drop. Show at 9:00 PM.

tip: New Year's Eve CAA conference opener! Afternoon tip-off at 4:00 PM at TD Arena before downtown NYE celebrations.

name: College of Charleston Men's Basketball vs. North Carolina A&T
tip: New Year's weekend Saturday conference battle vs. NC A&T Aggies. Tip-off at 4:00 PM at TD Arena.

name: South Carolina Restaurant Week (Winter Edition)

name: Rob Anderson: Work in Progress Show
tip: NYT bestselling author and viral comedy sensation developing his brand-new live multimedia stand-up show. Evening show at 7:00 PM.

name: Rumours ATL: A Fleetwood Mac Tribute
tip: The Southeast's premier Fleetwood Mac tribute band delivering precise vocal harmonies and high energy. Show at 8:00 PM.

tip: Saturday night South Division action vs. Atlanta. Great family sporting event; puck drops at 6:05 PM.

name: Second Sunday on King Street (January Edition)
venue: Lower King Street (Queen St to Calhoun St)
tip: Crisp winter afternoon stroll on vehicle-free King Street. Relaxed post-holiday shopping atmosphere with special winter sales and outdoor patio dining.

name: SC Stingrays vs. Jacksonville Icemen
tip: Sunday afternoon matinee vs. Jacksonville. Puck drops at 3:05 PM at North Charleston Coliseum.

name: College of Charleston Men's Basketball vs. Campbell
tip: Thursday night CAA conference matchup vs. Campbell Fighting Camels. Tip-off at 7:00 PM at TD Arena.

name: SC Stingrays vs. Tahoe Knight Monsters
tip: Historic first-ever meeting against new ECHL Western Conference franchise Tahoe. Puck drops at 7:05 PM.

name: Bo Johnson Live Stand-Up
tip: Featured on Comedy Central, Netflix is a Joke, and Just For Laughs Montreal. High-energy storytelling headliner. Friday–Sunday shows.

name: Charleston Half Marathon, 5K & Post-Race Finish Festival
tip: USATF-certified scenic race course winding past historic architecture, live oak canopies, and harbor vistas. Concludes with a celebratory Lowcountry shrimp and grits finish-line party.

tip: Queer Eye star and author Jonathan Van Ness headlines Charleston Comedy Week with joy-filled, hilarious stand-up. Show at 8:00 PM.

name: Hannibal Buress (Charleston Comedy Week)

tip: Pioneers of "Mountain Rock" blending funk, southern rock, and bluegrass banjo. Charleston club favorites for over 30 years. Doors at 6:00 PM, show at 7:00 PM.

tip: Celebrating the golden hits of Stevie Wonder, The Supremes, Marvin Gaye, and The Temptations arranged for full live orchestra and dynamic guest vocalists. Show at 7:30 PM.

tip: Saturday night in-state showdown vs. Greenville. Concourse giveaways and entertainment. Puck drops at 6:05 PM.

name: College of Charleston Men's Basketball vs. Hofstra
tip: Saturday afternoon showdown vs. top CAA rival Hofstra Pride. High-energy arena atmosphere. Tip-off at 2:00 PM.

name: Lowcountry Oyster Festival
tip: The world's largest oyster festival, featuring 80,000+ pounds of steamed local clusters, oyster shucking contests, and live music. VIP tickets offer covered dining and private raw bars. Bring garden gloves!

name: Steven Rogers Live Stand-Up
tip: Colbert and Corden regular touring alongside Nate Bargatze and Brian Regan. Witty, endearing autobiographical stand-up. Thursday–Saturday shows.

name: Charleston Gallery Association First Friday Artwalk (February)
venue: French Quarter Historic District (2 blocks from The Palmetto)
tip: Pre-SEWE fine art previews and winter exhibitions across French Quarter galleries from 5:00 PM - 8:00 PM with wine and light refreshments.

name: SC Stingrays vs. Orlando Solar Bears
tip: Saturday evening clash vs. Orlando. High-energy crowd favorite. Puck drops at 7:05 PM.

name: Best of Broadway: HAMILTON
tip: The landmark Tony Award-winning Broadway musical returns to the Lowcountry for a limited two-week engagement. Premier cultural booking for February hotel guests.

name: South Carolina Ballet: Sleeping Beauty
tip: Valentine's season fairy-tale ballet classic featuring the South Carolina Ballet company. Shows at 7:30 PM. Perfect pre-Valentine date.

name: College of Charleston Men's Basketball vs. Stony Brook
tip: Thursday evening CAA conference battle vs. Stony Brook Seawolves. Tip-off at 7:00 PM at TD Arena.

name: Southeastern Wildlife Exposition (SEWE)
venue: Charleston Place, Brittlebank Park, Marion Square
tip: Charleston's premier winter event. DockDogs diving competitions at Brittlebank, birds of prey flight demonstrations, and world-class sporting art in the ballrooms. Entire town buzzes all weekend.

name: The Play That Goes Wrong
venue: Queen Street Playhouse (20 Queen St - 4 min walk)
tip: Olivier and Tony Award-winning physical comedy farce following an amateur murder mystery where everything that can go wrong does. Laugh-out-loud weekend entertainment.

name: Second Sunday on King Street (February Edition)
venue: Lower King Street (Queen St to Calhoun St)
tip: Valentine's Day edition! Perfect romantic afternoon stroll pairing champagne, chocolates from Christophe Artisan, and street performers.

name: SC Stingrays vs. Jacksonville Icemen
tip: Annual Education Day special morning game! Morning puck drop at 10:30 AM with enthusiastic school crowds.

name: Three Dog Night Live in Concert
tip: Legendary vocal group with 21 consecutive Billboard Top 40 hits ("Joy to the World", "Mama Told Me Not to Come", "Black & White"). Show at 8:00 PM.

tip: Friday night weekend opener against Atlanta. Puck drops at 7:05 PM at North Charleston Coliseum.

tip: Saturday night divisional matchup vs. Jacksonville. Puck drops at 6:05 PM.

tip: New York Times bestselling cookbook author and Substack culinary creator Caroline Chambers hosts an intimate live evening of culinary stories, cooking demos, and cocktail tasting.

tip: Late-season conference action vs. Hampton Pirates at TD Arena. Tip-off at 7:00 PM.

tip: Three-game weekend series opener vs. defending champions Florida Everblades. Puck drops at 7:05 PM.

tip: Saturday night clash vs. Florida. High-level pro hockey atmosphere. Puck drops at 6:05 PM.

tip: Sunday afternoon series finale vs. Florida Everblades. Puck drops at 3:05 PM.

name: College of Charleston Men's Basketball vs. UNCW
tip: Regular Season Home Finale & Senior Day! Fierce rivalry clash vs. UNCW Seahawks. Tip-off at 4:00 PM at TD Arena.

name: BLUEY'S BIG PLAY: The Stage Show
tip: Brand-new theatrical adaptation of the Emmy-winning children's television series featuring brilliantly created puppets and original music. Multiple afternoon and evening performances.

name: Charleston Wine + Food Festival
tip: The nation's benchmark culinary celebration. The Culinary Village at Riverfront Park is the core highlight, while intimate signature dinners in historic mansions sell out within minutes of release in October.
ticket: Ticket Required per Event / Village Pass ($150–$350)

name: Charleston City Market Night Market (Spring Season Opening)
venue: Historic Charleston City Market (Church to East Bay St)
tip: Spring weekend evening market (Friday & Saturday 6:30 PM - 10:30 PM). Just two blocks west of the hotel. Perfect after-dinner stroll.

name: Charleston Gallery Association First Friday Artwalk (March)
venue: French Quarter Historic District (2 blocks from The Palmetto)
tip: Spring gallery openings showcasing vibrant Lowcountry landscapes, plein air paintings, and modern bronze sculptures.

name: Daughtry Live in Concert
tip: Multi-platinum post-grunge rock band fronted by Chris Daughtry performing their biggest anthems and new material. Show at 8:00 PM.

name: North Charleston POPS! John Williams Greatest Hits
tip: Epic cinematic symphonic concert featuring legendary film scores from Star Wars, Jurassic Park, Indiana Jones, and E.T. Conducted live at 7:30 PM.

name: Bumpin Uglies & Ballyhoo! Beach Bash
tip: Spring kickoff outdoor concert on the oceanfront NÜTRL Beach Stage! Reggae-rock and ska favorites on the sand. Show begins at 6:00 PM.

name: SC Stingrays vs. Jacksonville Icemen
tip: Saturday night late-season playoff push vs. Jacksonville. Puck drops at 6:05 PM.

name: Second Sunday on King Street (March Spring Edition)
venue: Lower King Street (Queen St to Calhoun St)
tip: Spring fashion debuts and warm March weather. King Street transforms into a pedestrian park with sidewalk cafes and street performers from 12:00 PM to 5:00 PM.

name: SC Stingrays vs. Jacksonville Icemen
tip: Sunday afternoon matinee vs. Jacksonville. Puck drops at 3:05 PM.

name: The Charleston Festival (Historic Houses & Secret Gardens)
venue: South of Broad, French Quarter & Historic Peninsula
tip: Celebrating its 80th anniversary! Rare, exclusive access into private historic residences and secluded courtyard gardens normally closed to the public. Morning and afternoon walking tours sell out months ahead.
ticket: Ticket Required ($65–$125 per tour / Advance Purchase Crucial)

name: The Charleston Show: Antiques, Art & Design
tip: Premier annual decorative arts show gathering over 30 top national dealers showcasing fine English, American, and Continental furniture, vintage estate jewelry, architectural elements, and fine Southern art.

name: SC Stingrays vs. Greenville Swamp Rabbits
tip: Friday night in-state rivalry game vs. Greenville. High intensity; puck drops at 7:05 PM.

name: SC Stingrays vs. Atlanta Gladiators
tip: Saturday night weekend matchup vs. Atlanta. Great for families and sports fans. Puck drops at 6:05 PM.

name: SC Stingrays vs. Atlanta Gladiators
tip: Sunday afternoon matinee vs. Atlanta Gladiators. Puck drops at 3:05 PM.

name: SC Stingrays vs. Savannah Ghost Pirates
tip: Friday night showdown vs. Savannah. Heated rivalry hockey; puck drops at 7:05 PM.

name: SC Stingrays vs. Savannah Ghost Pirates
tip: Saturday night rematch against Savannah. Puck drops at 6:05 PM at North Charleston Coliseum.

name: Best of Broadway: THE NOTEBOOK
tip: Critically acclaimed new Broadway musical based on the bestselling novel by Nicholas Sparks. Set in coastal South Carolina; a deeply moving theatrical experience.

name: Charleston Gallery Association First Friday Artwalk (April)
venue: French Quarter Historic District (2 blocks from The Palmetto)
tip: One of the busiest artwalks of the year! Enjoy blooming window boxes, live music on street corners, and wine tastings inside historic art spaces.

name: Summerville Flowertown Festival
venue: Azalea Park & Downtown Summerville (30 min drive)
tip: The premier spring craft and floral festival in the Lowcountry. Over 200 juried artisans, food trucks, and blooming pink azaleas, dogwoods, and wisteria beneath Spanish moss.

name: SC Stingrays vs. Jacksonville Icemen
tip: Final weekend of regular season home play! Friday night clash vs. Jacksonville. Puck drops at 7:05 PM.

name: Brandy Clark Live in Concert
tip: Grammy and Tony Award-winning country and Americana singer-songwriter (co-composer of Shucked on Broadway). Exceptional acoustic storytelling. Show at 8:00 PM.

name: Cooper River Bridge Run (44th Annual 10K)
venue: Mount Pleasant to Downtown Charleston (Arthur Ravenel Jr. Bridge)
tip: One of the largest, most iconic 10K races in the world (35,000+ participants). Spectacular panoramic sunrise views crossing the 2.5-mile cable-stayed bridge. Downtown streets party all afternoon post-race.

name: Credit One Charleston Open (WTA 500 Tennis)
tip: North America's largest women-only professional tennis tournament. Features world-ranked Grand Slam champions playing on green clay. Stadium food village features local Charleston chefs, craft beer, and live music.

name: SC Stingrays vs. Jacksonville Icemen
tip: Regular Season Home Finale & Fan Appreciation Night! Concourse giveaways and team salutes. Puck drops at 6:05 PM.

name: St. Paul & The Broken Bones Live on the Beach Stage
tip: Electrifying Alabama soul powerhouses performing sunset show directly on the oceanfront beach stage. Unmatched vocal energy. Show at 6:00 PM.

name: Charleston Jazz Festival
tip: Celebrates Charleston's rich jazz roots with performances by internationally acclaimed Grammy-winning artists alongside local Gullah jazz virtuosos. Book headline theater shows well in advance.

name: Lowcountry Cajun Festival
venue: James Island County Park (15 min drive)
tip: Full-day Louisiana bayou celebration with authentic Cajun and Creole delicacies: crawfish boils, jambalaya, alligator bites, and beignets. Two stages feature live Zydeco and Cajun accordion bands with dance floors.

name: Second Sunday on King Street (April Edition)
venue: Lower King Street (Queen St to Calhoun St)
tip: Peaks with spring blooms, outdoor cafe tables, and tournament visitors from the Credit One Open. Excellent atmosphere for people-watching and local boutique shopping.

name: North Charleston POPS! American Road Trip
tip: A musical journey across the United States exploring bluegrass, jazz, Americana, and Southern folk arranged for full orchestra.

name: Jason Isbell & The 400 Unit with Nathaniel Rateliff
tip: Grammy-winning Americana titan Jason Isbell co-headlining with Nathaniel Rateliff & The Night Sweats outdoors on the Firefly lawn. The premier spring outdoor concert.

name: Town of Mount Pleasant Blessing of the Fleet & Seafood Festival
venue: Mount Pleasant Memorial Waterfront Park (Under the Bridge)
tip: Honoring the local shrimping industry since 1988. Boat parade along the harbor with blessings of colorful shrimping trawlers, shrimp-eating contest, shag dancing contest, and fresh seafood vendors.

name: Best of Broadway: HELL'S KITCHEN
tip: The smash-hit new Broadway musical conceived by 16-time Grammy Award winner Alicia Keys, featuring her iconic anthems and brand-new original songs.

name: North Charleston Arts Fest
venue: Charleston Area Convention Center & Park Circle
tip: Five-day regional arts celebration presenting visual art galleries, photography competitions, theater, dance performances, craft vendors, and hands-on family activities.

name: Charleston Gallery Association First Friday Artwalk (May)
venue: French Quarter Historic District (2 blocks from The Palmetto)
tip: Pre-Spoleto artist spotlights and evening receptions. An easy, delightful 2-hour walking tour beginning right outside The Palmetto Hotel.

name: Piccolo Spoleto Festival
venue: Marion Square, Waterfront Park & Charleston Neighborhoods
tip: Spoleto's vibrant companion festival focusing on southeastern artists. Features the Marion Square Juried Outdoor Art Show, free sunset concerts at Waterfront Park, and puppet shows in shaded historic gardens.

name: Spoleto Festival USA (51st Season Opening)
venue: Gaillard Center, Dock Street Theatre, College of Charleston Cistern
tip: America's premier international performing arts festival. Over 120 opera, symphonic, chamber music, theater, and modern dance performances across historic courtyards and theaters. Cistern Yard twilight concerts are pure magic.

name: Annual Sweetgrass Cultural Arts Festival
tip: Celebrates the living Gullah Geechee heritage of Sweetgrass basket weaving, a centuries-old tradition brought by enslaved West Africans. Watch master weavers, taste Gullah rice dishes, and listen to storytelling.

name: Carolina Day Historic Peninsula Commemoration
venue: White Point Garden (The Battery) & St. Michael's Church
tip: Commemorates the 1776 Battle of Sullivan's Island (the first decisive American victory of the Revolution). Includes a fife and drum parade down Meeting St to White Point Garden with palmetto wreath laying and musket salutes.

name: Patriots Point 4th of July Blast & Harbor Fireworks
venue: USS Yorktown Flight Deck & Charleston Harbor
tip: The largest Independence Day fireworks show in South Carolina, launched over Charleston Harbor directly opposite The Palmetto. Watch from the flight deck of the historic aircraft carrier USS Yorktown or Waterfront Park pier.
ticket: Flight Deck Ticket Required ($35–$125) / Waterfront Park Pier Free

name: Story Stroll
venue: Magnolia Plantation & Gardens (3550 Ashley River Rd - 25 min drive)
tip: Interactive outdoor children's story walk through historic garden paths beneath the live oaks. Included with general garden admission.

name: Airing of the Quilts
venue: Magnolia Plantation & Gardens (3550 Ashley River Rd - 25 min drive)
tip: Spectacular outdoor heritage display of handmade quilts by the West Ashley Quilting Group and Island Quilters Guild draped over veranda rails and garden bridges.

name: Blueprint: The Art & Science of Cyanotype Printing
venue: Magnolia Plantation & Gardens (3550 Ashley River Rd - 25 min drive)
tip: Unique sun-printing photographic workshop exploring the intersection of art and botanical science using natural garden foliage and sunlight.

name: Stretch & Sip: A Mindful Morning at Magnolia
venue: Magnolia Plantation & Gardens (3550 Ashley River Rd - 25 min drive)
tip: Gentle morning yoga flow beneath centuries-old live oaks followed by a relaxed Lowcountry brunch and mimosas. Bring your own yoga mat.

name: Magnolia's Wine Stroll Series (with Raven Station)
venue: Magnolia Plantation & Gardens (3550 Ashley River Rd - 25 min drive)
tip: Evening stroll through America's oldest romantic gardens with complimentary wine and craft beer tastings paired with live bluegrass and acoustic tunes by Raven Station.

name: Paint & Sip Class at Magnolia
venue: Magnolia Plantation & Gardens (3550 Ashley River Rd - 25 min drive)
tip: Guided acrylic landscape painting workshop on the garden veranda with wine, all painting supplies, and canvas to take home.

name: A Gospel Christmas with Oh Happy Day
venue: Magnolia Plantation & Gardens (3550 Ashley River Rd - 25 min drive)
tip: Soul-stirring holiday concert exploring the rich cultural origins of African American gospel music and spirituals with Charleston vocal ensemble Oh Happy Day.

name: Bark the Halls 5K Trail Run
venue: Magnolia Plantation & Gardens (3550 Ashley River Rd - 25 min drive)
tip: Dog-friendly 5K trail run through garden pathways lined with blooming winter camellias and ancient cypress swamps. Dog bandanas and post-race hot cider included.

name: Gullah Doll Making Class with Genya Watson
venue: Magnolia Plantation & Gardens (3550 Ashley River Rd - 25 min drive)
tip: Intimate hands-on folk art class crafting traditional handcrafted Gullah cloth dolls with master artisan Genya Watson. Authentic Lowcountry cultural keepsake.

name: Winter Birding Tours with Robert Heise
venue: Magnolia Plantation & Gardens (3550 Ashley River Rd - 25 min drive)
tip: Guided morning bird walk along the Audubon Swamp Boardwalk and marsh dikes with expert naturalist Robert Heise. Anhingas, wood ducks, and egrets are plentiful in December.

name: Paint & Sip Class: Winter Holiday Edition
venue: Magnolia Plantation & Gardens (3550 Ashley River Rd - 25 min drive)
tip: Seasonal holiday painting session in the Carriage House with wine, cider, and holiday treats.

name: Candlelit Holiday Concert by Ethos String Quartet
venue: Magnolia Plantation & Gardens (3550 Ashley River Rd - 25 min drive)
tip: Intimate, candlelit evening chamber performance of classical holiday masterworks and carols by Music by Ethos string quartet in the Carriage House.

name: Pup Country Candle Making Class
venue: Magnolia Plantation & Gardens (3550 Ashley River Rd - 25 min drive)
tip: Hands-on artisanal soy wax candle pouring workshop in the Magnolia workshop with Pup Country Candles. Custom Lowcountry botanical scents.
